cues.en: In this video, I'm going to introduce you to something called the Order of Operations.
cues.zh: 這段影片介紹所謂的運算順序。

cues.en: This is an important principle in arithmetic and also for implementing arithmetic in code.
cues.zh: 這是算術的重要原則，用程式實作算術時也一樣。

cues.en: You will also see the importance of spacing and parentheses in Python in particular, you will learn
cues.zh: 也會看到空白和括號在 Python 裡的重要性。具體而言，

cues.en: that spacing is important for visualization, whereas parentheses are important for grouping of terms together.
cues.zh: 空白有助於視覺閱讀，括號則是用來把項目分成一組。

cues.en: Now, I'd like to begin with what seems like it should be a really simple arithmetic equation.
cues.zh: 先從一個看起來非常簡單的算式開始。

cues.en: Four plus three times two minus one equals.
cues.zh: 4 加 3 乘以 2 減 1，等於，

cues.en: Well, what does it actually equal here?
cues.zh: 這裡到底等於多少？

cues.en: There is in fact multiple ways that we can interpret this equation and the answer that we will get will depend on how we interpret these arithmetic operations.
cues.zh: 其實有好幾種解讀方式，答案取決於如何理解這些算術運算。

cues.en: So, for example, we can interpret this equation by grouping together the four and the three.
cues.zh: 例如，可以把 4 和 3 放在同一組。

cues.en: So we can say four plus three equals seven times two, minus one equals 13.
cues.zh: 4 加 3 是 7，再乘以 2、減 1，等於 13。

cues.en: And even here we could break up this ambiguity or we could break up this equation and even different ways.
cues.zh: 即使到這裡，還是能用不同方式解讀，或拆解這個算式。

cues.en: So here I'm grouping together seven times.
cues.zh: 這裡把 7 乘以，

cues.en: Two is fourteen, minus one is thirteen.
cues.zh: 2 放在一組，得到 14，再減 1，等於 13。

cues.en: But I also could have interpreted this differently to say seven times two minus one and two minus one is one times seven is seven.
cues.zh: 但也能解讀成 7 乘以括號裡的 2 減 1。2 減 1 是 1，再乘以 7，是 7。

cues.en: So we could have even gotten a different answer here.
cues.zh: 這樣又得到不同答案。

cues.en: Here's an alternative way to interpret this equation.
cues.zh: 另一種解讀方式，

cues.en: We can say four plus six and the six comes from grouping together three times two minus one equals nine.
cues.zh: 是 4 加 6，其中 6 來自把 3 乘以 2 分成一組，再減 1，等於 9。

cues.en: And again, here, we can also group the four plus six to be ten.
cues.zh: 這裡也能先算 4 加 6，得到 10，

cues.en: Minus one equals nine or four plus six minus one, which is five.
cues.zh: 再減 1，等於 9；或先算 6 減 1，得到 5，再加 4。

cues.en: In that case, they both end up being nine.
cues.zh: 這次兩種方式都得到 9。

cues.en: And there is yet another way to interpret this equation.
cues.zh: 還有另一種解讀。

cues.en: We can grouped together two minus one and that gives us four plus three times one.
cues.zh: 把 2 減 1 放在一組，就變成 4 加 3 乘以 1，

cues.en: And the answer here would be seven.
cues.zh: 答案是 7。

cues.en: And again, this also happens to work out to be seven, regardless of whether we say four plus three
cues.zh: 這次不管先算 4 加 3，

cues.en: is seven times one is still seven or four plus three times one is three and then plus four is still seven.
cues.zh: 得到 7，再乘以 1，仍然是 7；或先算 3 乘以 1 得到 3，再加 4，也都是 7。

cues.en: So it turns out that the correct answer here to this equation is nine.
cues.zh: 但這個算式的正確答案，其實是 9。

cues.en: This is the correct answer.
cues.zh: 這才是正確答案。

cues.en: Now, how do I know that it's this answer and not this or this or any of the other possibilities?
cues.zh: 我怎麼知道是這個，而不是另外這些，或其他可能答案？

cues.en: Well, the answer comes from this thing called the order of operations in the order of operations is
cues.zh: 答案來自運算順序。運算順序是，

cues.en: a sequential list of which arithmetic operations take precedence or priority over other arithmetic operations.
cues.zh: 一份有先後次序的規則，指出哪些算術運算優先於其他運算。

cues.en: So here's the order of operations.
cues.zh: 順序如下。

cues.en: We first prioritize parentheses and then exponents and then multiplication and division and finally addition and subtraction.
cues.zh: 先處理括號，再處理次方，再來乘除，最後加減。

cues.en: So that basically means that multiplication takes precedence over addition.
cues.zh: 基本上就是乘法優先於加法。

cues.en: And so that's why we group these two are that's why it's correct to group these two terms together.
cues.zh: 所以這兩項會分成一組，或者說這樣分組才正確。

cues.en: So three times two instead of grouping four plus three.
cues.zh: 先算 3 乘以 2，而不是 4 加 3。

cues.en: So four plus three addition is further down the list compared to multiplication.
cues.zh: 4 加 3 是加法，在順序上排在乘法後面。

cues.en: Now, this might seem like it's a really weird list and hard to remember, and that's why people have come up with memory tricks or harmonics to remember this order.
cues.zh: 你可能覺得這個清單很奇怪、很難記，所以人們想出一些記憶技巧，也就是口訣。

cues.en: So you can remember, PTM, these assets, pendas or some people have converted this into a weird sentence
cues.zh: 可以記 PEMDAS，或者有人把它變成一句奇怪的句子，

cues.en: and say, please excuse my dear Aunt Sally.
cues.zh: Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally。

cues.en: So parentheses, exponents, multiplication, division, addition and subtraction.
cues.zh: 分別代表括號、指數、乘法、除法、加法、減法。

cues.en: OK, so the order of operations pendas us, please excuse my dear Aunt Sally that tells us that we should
cues.zh: PEMDAS，也就是 Please Excuse My Dear Aunt Sally，告訴我們，

cues.zh: 要先把這幾項放在一組，因為乘法優先於加減。

cues.en: Now, that's why this is the right grouping here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡才應該這樣分組。

cues.en: And the question is now, how do we know that is supposed to be four plus six grouped together and then minus one and not four plus and then grouped together six minus one.

cues.en: So here, the way that the Pendas order of operations works is that it's really the grouping is really or the order is really parentheses.

cues.en: Exponents, multiplication and division are kind of treated the same.
cues.zh: 再指數，而乘法和除法視為同一個層級，

cues.en: An addition and subtraction are kind of treated the same.
cues.zh: 加法和減法也視為同一個層級。

cues.en: So when you see addition and subtraction, it's not necessarily the case that addition always takes priority over subtraction.
cues.zh: 因此，看到加法和減法，不代表加法一定優先於減法。

cues.en: Instead, if you see addition and subtraction, then you interpret them left to right.
cues.zh: 而是從左到右處理。

cues.en: So the correct grouping here would be four plus six gives you 10 and then minus one equals nine.
cues.zh: 所以正確的分組，是先算 4 加 6 得到 10，再減 1，等於 9。

cues.en: And that's because in terms of pendas, they are, you know, addition and subtraction are kind of equal.
cues.zh: 因為 PEMDAS 裡，加減是相同層級，

cues.en: But we read this from left to right.
cues.zh: 但我們由左向右讀。

cues.en: So we interpret this first and then this.
cues.zh: 因此先處理這個，再處理這個。

cues.en: So, for example, so the same thing would be if it were multiplication and division.
cues.zh: 乘法和除法也一樣。

cues.en: So, for example, if this were four divided by three instead of four plus three, then we would have
cues.zh: 例如，這裡如果是 4 除以 3，而不是 4 加 3，

cues.en: division and multiplication here and then we would actually interpret the four divided by three first because we're reading left, right over here.
